poc_details: Scope: Hosted API embeddings for two weeks, baseline & stress tests, then transition plan to Dedicated if metrics satisfied.
Test dataset: 300k seeded docs + 200k incremental customer tickets simulated, average doc length 800 tokens.
Throughput targets: 100 sustained QPS for embedding generation; 500 QPS read-only vector lookups during ad-hoc queries.
Latency targets: embedding generation p50 <50ms, p95 <150ms on Dedicated; end-to-end search p50 <50ms including Pinecone lookup.
Batch job targets: nightly re-embed window for 500k docs completed in <4 hours (preferably <3h), ability to run incremental runs without full reingest.
Success metrics: per-embed cost below $0.0015 (hosted baseline), search quality measured by MRR improvement >=12% versus keyword baseline.
Fail criteria: nightly re-embed extends beyond 6 hours; p95 search latency >300ms; cost per embed >2x projected budget.
Metrics capture: Diego to publish benchmark results to linked Drive sheet and attach Fireflies clips for major runs.
